events.title: PSG vs Barcelona - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch PSG and Barcelona go head-to-head on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. With both European giants winning their opening two league-phase matches, a blockbuster showdown awaits at the Parc des Princes.

events.title: Liverpool vs Villarreal - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Liverpool and Villarreal go head-to-head in a crucial UEFA Champions League clash at Anfield. With Liverpool seeking a third straight league-phase win and Villarreal aiming to climb the standings, all eyes will be on this Matchday 3 encounter.

events.title: Man City vs AEK Athens - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Manchester City take on AEK Athens on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. With both sides level on three points after two matches, a crucial result could provide a major boost in the league-phase standings.

events.title: Stuttgart vs Atleti - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Stuttgart and Atlético Madrid go head-to-head on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. Two ambitious sides meet with valuable points at stake as the league phase gathers momentum.

events.title: Roma vs S. Bratislava - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Roma host Slovan Bratislava in an important UEFA Champions League encounter. With both teams eager to improve their standing after difficult starts to the league phase, all three points will be vital in Rome.

events.title: Napoli vs Bodø/Glimt - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Napoli take on Bodø/Glimt on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. With the Italian side still searching for their first points of the league phase and the visitors aiming to build on their winning start, an intriguing contest awaits in Naples.

events.title: Porto vs PSV - 21 Oct 2026
events.synopsis: Watch Porto and PSV go head-to-head on Matchday 3 of the UEFA Champions League. Valuable points are up for grabs as both teams aim to strengthen their position in the league-phase table.
